final_rationale: The verdict does not change because the Actor supplied no new admissible evidence and mainly narrowed the claim using the same record. That clarification is directionally correct, but it does not cure the core defect in the present packet. The policy is conditional: certification may proceed only if current release documentation reflects current evaluation results and material segment weaknesses are disclosed, or if an approved mitigation covers the weakness. The admissible record still does not show either predicate has been met. This is the key distinction between a caveated compliant position and the current case: a caveat can support compliant_with_caveats only when the caveat describes an already-satisfied policy-bounded condition in the record, not when it identifies a missing compliance prerequisite. On this record, caveated compliance is not established; the unresolved documentation or mitigation predicate keeps the certification claim suspicious.
